definitions.gloss: useful tool; convenient device; sharp instrument
definitions.explanation: A handy implement or technology that makes work easier. Most often appears in the set phrase {文明|ぶんめい}の{利器|りき} (the conveniences of civilization).

examples.japanese: スマホは{文明|ぶんめい}の{利器|りき}だ。
examples.english: The smartphone is a convenience of modern civilization.

examples.japanese: {洗濯機|せんたくき}は{家事|かじ}を{楽|らく}にする{利器|りき}だ。
examples.english: The washing machine is a handy device that makes housework easier.

examples.japanese: {文明|ぶんめい}の{利器|りき}に{頼|たよ}りすぎると、{不便|ふべん}な{状況|じょうきょう}に{弱|よわ}くなる。
examples.english: If you rely too much on the conveniences of civilization, you become helpless in inconvenient situations.

notes:
Compound of {利|り} (benefit, sharpness) + {器|き} (implement). Somewhat literary; in everyday use it almost always appears in the fixed phrase below.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文明|ぶんめい}の{利器|りき}: the conveniences of civilization (technology, gadgets)
- {最新|さいしん}の{利器|りき}: the latest convenient device

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {道具|どうぐ}: tool; implement — the ordinary, neutral word for any tool
- {器具|きぐ}: apparatus; appliance — a specific piece of equipment for a purpose
